name: winter_bisht_worried
shows: worried, mittens clasped at the chin, beside a small campfire, grey smoke, two blue worry marks
caution: worried face: never at the reader over a missed day, and never in a reminder (reminders never press or blame)

name: winter_bisht_burning_stick
shows: holding a stick whose tip caught fire over the campfire, alarmed, red double exclamation, blue sweat drops
caution: alarmed face with sweat drops: fine for a playful oops, not for a streak at risk

name: winter_bisht_squeeze_eyes
shows: eyes squeezed shut in a frown, both mittens held to the campfire, two grey swirls that read as question marks
caution: strained face beside two question marks: reads as confused or overwhelmed as much as cold; suits cold weather or warming up, never a verdict on the reader and never in a reminder

name: winter_bisht_grey_cloud
shows: sad, a dark grey cloud overhead, mittens on the ground by a small campfire
caution: sad face: the app's rule is that Doum never looks sad at the reader; keep it out of missed days and reminders

name: winter_bisht_blow_fire
shows: eyes shut, blowing on the campfire, a grey breath swirl

name: winter_bisht_warm_hands
shows: warming both mittens at the campfire, startled, gold lines, blue sweat drops (close to winter_cloak_campfire)
caution: startled face with sweat drops: fine for a playful surprise, never for a streak at risk or in a reminder (reminders never press or blame)

name: winter_bisht_happy_heart
shows: laughing, eyes shut, a big campfire in front, a pink heart, gold lines

name: winter_bisht_flame_up
shows: laughing, one mitten holding up a big flame, the other arm out, one gold sparkle, gold lines

name: winter_bisht_hourglass
shows: worried, a mitten at the mouth, beside an hourglass and a small campfire, red double exclamation, grey smoke
caution: time running out, worried: never on a streak at risk or in a reminder (reminders never press or blame)

name: winter_bisht_cold_wind
shows: worried, wrapped in the fur collar, cold wind with blue swirls and green leaves blowing, a small campfire
caution: worried face: suits cold weather, never a verdict on the reader

name: winter_bisht_dizzy_lying
shows: lying on the ground, tired and dizzy, a dark spiral overhead, a small campfire, grey smoke
caution: tired, unhappy face: never at the reader over a missed day; the spiral is dark brown and all but disappears on a dark card

name: winter_bisht_flame_hands
shows: eyes shut, smiling, a small flame cupped in both mittens, four gold sparkles
caution: eyes shut and hands cupped reads as calm and devout: keep it away from worship moments like every other pose (never in tasbih or prayer times)
